speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The chamber is aired. I did not undertake to keep a saddlery in the passage. That hired bag goes out tonight.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tonight. It has no business by the stair. You have been patient with it longer than the horse was.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Patience is for sermons. Mark me, the parish has been dull, which is how I like a parish. Two banns. One cracked pane in the close, and it is not my pane.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I swept the cracked side. The glass is still in. Mistress would not have a glazier for one crack.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A glazier is a guest, and guests want ale. Two banns need no ale from me. The third thing is paper, and it is not parish.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Whose paper?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Master Heminges. A note. I kept it on the tray, where your own papers could not bury it. Friday, at nine, the Theatre. His hand, not mine.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nine. I have it. The note calls the rehearsal, and the rehearsal may wait until I have been up the stair.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The cat is on your book again. I took him off twice. He counts the top of a book as a bed, and I am not a sermon.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Off Holinshed, sirrah. He's Master Field's, and Master Field counts.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The cat prefers a thick book. So do men who will not say what they are writing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not saying. The book stays Master Field's. Gib may have the floor.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: He will not take the floor while the book is warm. I have tried the floor.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Leave the animal. Tell me whether your wife had an opinion, and then go up. I have aired a room, not a play.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Her opinion waits. I have a list of hers to unpack before I touch my own notes. The list comes out of the bag first.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A list is a civilised object. Unpack it on the table, not on my stair. And the bag, tonight, as I said. I will not say it at supper.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The bag tonight. The list first. My own papers after. That is the order, and I am tired enough to keep an order.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: There was a man in the back room at his loom all the dull days. He asked nothing. I told him the horse was yours when I heard it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Master Verbeke keeps his room and his name. We do not improve either. Two banns, one pane, one note, one bag. I have delivered the parish.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Delivered. I will not ask you for a fifth item. The chamber may have me, and the book may have its cat until I lift him.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Lift him yourself. I air rooms. I do not argue with beasts about property. If you are not awake for supper, the house will survive a quiet stair.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I shall be quiet. The count is still to do, and then I am done with the day.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then count, and do not count aloud on my stair. A sum on a stair becomes a neighbour's sum. The ledger is a table's business.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will take the hired bag down when the list is out. Tonight, as she said. I am not a saddlery.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tonight. The list first, on the table, and not read to the house. Then the locks.
